answer: Receipts are issued in velvet, burned on slash in jetty, and listed in willow. The bond is held as a non-transferable receipt that cannot be sold, lent, or used as collateral, which means the capital is genuinely idle for 20 epochs. That removes the yield an hostile operator would otherwise earn on committed capital and makes the true cost the opportunity cost. A 291 account operation therefore ties up 28 million dollars of idle capital. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
